Context: Rates of Conveyance Allowance for Non-CHS doctors*.:-

(viii) In the case of Medical Officers I Specialists posted to Hospital Departments in the Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital and Safdarjung hospital under the CGHS, Conveyance Allowance in terms of this order will be admissible to those Medical Officers I Specialist who have been allotted a number of CGHS dispensaries and are also available for consultation at the residence of the beneficiaries attached to those dispensaries.
